issue.title: (slightly off-topic) How to 'reset' Gazebo after running integrations tests?
issue.body:
Hi,

v0.42.0
I ran the integrations tests and now running the  MAVSDK example fly_mission (with custom waypoints next to the home point) and now I get "MAVLink: critical: Geofence violation for waypoint". Which is understandable since I ran the integration tests...

Is there a way to reset/clear Gazebo? I couldn't find an answer in the MAVSDK issues...

Thanks

comments.body: I just restart it :sweat_smile:. I don't think there is a way, to be honest
No way, that doesn’t work for me...?! Of course, I tried that 😛
I think what @JonasVautherin means is you need to stop PX4 and relaunch it. That should start the gazebo simulation environment in a fresh state.

Hi Ramon,
Yes, that’s how I interpreted Jonas’ suggestion, thanks. I also restarted the machine and the geofence violation was still there.

I now realized that it is indeed px4 that does the sitl, thanks.

I remember that I also ran px4 unit tests and integrations tests so maybe the state is stored in the px4 source tree. Not sure, I am learning about px4, mavsdk, etc

I have now ‘fixed’ the issue by using a fresh clone and build of the px4…
It's possible that PX4 stores some values to make the build faster, in those cases I recommend you run 'make clean' it's faster than a fresh clone
Fyi, I tried that but no change. Actually, I did not expect this to be honest since 'make clean' is a build command. Anyway, it's not important for now.

To reset the geofence, we would either have to remove the file in the PX4 build directory which stores the geofence, or remove the geofence again after the geofence integration test. I suggest to implement the latter.

Yes, that sounds right to me too.
For my understanding, which file stores the geofence, do you know that? Is there documentation about these sitl runtime files?
